// !!! NOT COMPILED IN UNITY: Roslyn type-check only (Common/Tools~/compile_check). Compile with UdonSharp and check. !!!
//
// THIS FILE IS GENERATED by 蓝白/Director/1 Generate Dispatcher (Director/Editor/LanbaiDirectorGen.cs) from the act
// drivers found in the project. Do not edit by hand: re-run the menu after adding a package. The checked-in version has
// no drivers (it compiles on its own); the generated one has one typed array per driver class.
//
// Why generated: UdonSharp can call LanbaiTick(float) on another behaviour only through a reference of that behaviour's
// own class (a call on a plain UdonSharpBehaviour / UdonBehaviour cannot pass the argument). So the dispatcher holds one
// typed array per driver class and the interface of CONTROL_总控.md §5 stays exactly as the packages wrote it:
//     public void    LanbaiTick(float t)      every frame while t is inside the window
//     public void    LanbaiActivate(bool on)  when t enters / leaves the window (the window must begin and end under an
//                                             occluder: black, white, inside a cloud, under water)
//     public float[] LanbaiWindow()           {t0, t1} (timeline seconds, warm-up included); read once in Start()
//
// LB_Journey (local) calls, once per frame after its own work:   dispatcher.LanbaiDispatch(t);
// and at spawn, under the 3 s black (bible §1.9):                dispatcher.LanbaiPrewarm();
// Optional 4th driver method (bible §1.4: ONE dEV per frame, ONE writer of the PPv2 weights = LB_Journey.ApplyGrades):
//     public float[] LanbaiGrade(float t)     {dEV, whiteSat, whiteBloom, lensCleanMul} for this frame, or null
//   The dispatcher calls it after LanbaiTick for drivers inside their window and sums: gradeDEV = sum dEV, gradeWhiteSat /
//   gradeWhiteBloom = max, gradeLensClean = min. LanbaiDispatch must therefore run BEFORE ApplyGrades in LB_Journey, and
//   ApplyGrades adds gradeDEV to its own events (dropping its own copy of any event a driver now reports).
// Drivers are ticked in class-name order, then scene order: deterministic. Two drivers whose windows overlap must not
// write the same thing (Engineering/README_集成.md §2).
// v1.1 — what a driver writes, for LB_Journey's takeover switches (README_集成 §3 / §8.3). Read once in Start():
//     public bool LanbaiWritesAtmosphere()   true = it writes RenderSettings fog / ambient during its window
//     public bool LanbaiWritesSun()          true = it writes the one shadowed main light during its window
//   a driver without these methods but with public bool fields writeRenderSettings / writeMainLight is read through the
//   fields (the inside and the sea drivers); a driver with neither writes neither. Results:
//     atmosphereWindowsFlat / sunWindowsFlat  (t0, t1 pairs), LanbaiCoversAtmosphere(t) / LanbaiCoversSun(t)
//   LB_Journey skips its own RenderSettings writes where LanbaiCoversAtmosphere(t), its own sun writes where
//   LanbaiCoversSun(t). windowsFlat / LanbaiCovered(t) stay (every window, whatever the driver writes) for the old
//   placeholder groups.
using UdonSharp;
using UnityEngine;

[UdonBehaviourSyncMode(BehaviourSyncMode.None)]
public class LanbaiActDispatcher : UdonSharpBehaviour
{
    [Header("Read by LB_Journey (extWindows): every driver window, flattened t0, t1, t0, t1, ...")]
    public float[] windowsFlat = new float[0];
    [Header("v1.1: windows of the drivers that write RenderSettings (atmosphere) / the main light (sun); read by LB_Journey")]
    public float[] atmosphereWindowsFlat = new float[0];
    public float[] sunWindowsFlat = new float[0];
    [Header("Exposure events summed from the drivers (optional LanbaiGrade(t)); read by LB_Journey.ApplyGrades")]
    public bool gradeOwned;          // some driver reported grade events this frame
    public float gradeDEV;           // sum of every driver's dEV (EV; ApplyGrades adds it to its own dEV, then solves EXPO_UP/DOWN)
    public float gradeWhiteSat;      // max of the drivers' WHITE_SAT weights
    public float gradeWhiteBloom;    // max of the drivers' WHITE_BLOOM weights
    public float gradeLensClean = 1; // min of the drivers' desktop lens-layer multipliers (1 = untouched)
    [Header("Debug")]
    public float lastT = -1f;
    public int activeCount;
    public int prewarmFrames = 2;

    private int _prewarm = -1;

    // <LANBAI-GENERATED-FIELDS>
    public Lanbai.Act09.LanbaiAct09Driver[] d0;          // LanbaiAct09Driver
    private bool[] d0_on;
    private float[] d0_w;
    public Lanbai.Sky.LanbaiSkyDriver[] d1;          // LanbaiSkyDriver
    private bool[] d1_on;
    private float[] d1_w;
    public LanbaiAct07Driver[] d2;          // LanbaiAct07Driver
    private bool[] d2_on;
    private float[] d2_w;
    public LanbaiGateDriver[] d3;          // LanbaiGateDriver
    private bool[] d3_on;
    private float[] d3_w;
    public LanbaiInsideDriver[] d4;          // LanbaiInsideDriver
    private bool[] d4_on;
    private float[] d4_w;
    // </LANBAI-GENERATED-FIELDS>

    void Start()
    {
        int n = 0;
        // <LANBAI-GENERATED-START>
        if (d0 == null) d0 = new Lanbai.Act09.LanbaiAct09Driver[0];
        d0_on = new bool[d0.Length];
        d0_w = new float[2 * d0.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < d0.Length; i++)
        {
            d0_w[2 * i] = 1e9f; d0_w[2 * i + 1] = -1e9f;
            if (d0[i] == null) continue;
            float[] w = d0[i].LanbaiWindow();
            if (w != null && w.Length >= 2) { d0_w[2 * i] = w[0]; d0_w[2 * i + 1] = w[1]; n++; }
        }
        if (d1 == null) d1 = new Lanbai.Sky.LanbaiSkyDriver[0];
        d1_on = new bool[d1.Length];
        d1_w = new float[2 * d1.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < d1.Length; i++)
        {
            d1_w[2 * i] = 1e9f; d1_w[2 * i + 1] = -1e9f;
            if (d1[i] == null) continue;
            float[] w = d1[i].LanbaiWindow();
            if (w != null && w.Length >= 2) { d1_w[2 * i] = w[0]; d1_w[2 * i + 1] = w[1]; n++; }
        }
        if (d2 == null) d2 = new LanbaiAct07Driver[0];
        d2_on = new bool[d2.Length];
        d2_w = new float[2 * d2.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < d2.Length; i++)
        {
            d2_w[2 * i] = 1e9f; d2_w[2 * i + 1] = -1e9f;
            if (d2[i] == null) continue;
            float[] w = d2[i].LanbaiWindow();
            if (w != null && w.Length >= 2) { d2_w[2 * i] = w[0]; d2_w[2 * i + 1] = w[1]; n++; }
        }
        if (d3 == null) d3 = new LanbaiGateDriver[0];
        d3_on = new bool[d3.Length];
        d3_w = new float[2 * d3.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < d3.Length; i++)
        {
            d3_w[2 * i] = 1e9f; d3_w[2 * i + 1] = -1e9f;
            if (d3[i] == null) continue;
            float[] w = d3[i].LanbaiWindow();
            if (w != null && w.Length >= 2) { d3_w[2 * i] = w[0]; d3_w[2 * i + 1] = w[1]; n++; }
        }
        if (d4 == null) d4 = new LanbaiInsideDriver[0];
        d4_on = new bool[d4.Length];
        d4_w = new float[2 * d4.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < d4.Length; i++)
        {
            d4_w[2 * i] = 1e9f; d4_w[2 * i + 1] = -1e9f;
            if (d4[i] == null) continue;
            float[] w = d4[i].LanbaiWindow();
            if (w != null && w.Length >= 2) { d4_w[2 * i] = w[0]; d4_w[2 * i + 1] = w[1]; n++; }
        }
        // </LANBAI-GENERATED-START>
        windowsFlat = new float[2 * n];
        n = 0;
        int na = 0, ns = 0;
        // <LANBAI-GENERATED-WINDOWS>
        for (int i = 0; i < d0.Length; i++)
        {
            if (d0_w[2 * i] > d0_w[2 * i + 1]) continue;
            windowsFlat[2 * n] = d0_w[2 * i]; windowsFlat[2 * n + 1] = d0_w[2 * i + 1]; n++;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < d1.Length; i++)
        {
            if (d1_w[2 * i] > d1_w[2 * i + 1]) continue;
            windowsFlat[2 * n] = d1_w[2 * i]; windowsFlat[2 * n + 1] = d1_w[2 * i + 1]; n++;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < d2.Length; i++)
        {
            if (d2_w[2 * i] > d2_w[2 * i + 1]) continue;
            windowsFlat[2 * n] = d2_w[2 * i]; windowsFlat[2 * n + 1] = d2_w[2 * i + 1]; n++;
            if (d2[i] != null && d2[i].writeRenderSettings) { atmosphereWindowsFlat = Grow(atmosphereWindowsFlat, 2 * na + 2); atmosphereWindowsFlat[2 * na] = d2_w[2 * i]; atmosphereWindowsFlat[2 * na + 1] = d2_w[2 * i + 1]; na++; }
            if (d2[i] != null && d2[i].writeMainLight) { sunWindowsFlat = Grow(sunWindowsFlat, 2 * ns + 2); sunWindowsFlat[2 * ns] = d2_w[2 * i]; sunWindowsFlat[2 * ns + 1] = d2_w[2 * i + 1]; ns++; }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < d3.Length; i++)
        {
            if (d3_w[2 * i] > d3_w[2 * i + 1]) continue;
            windowsFlat[2 * n] = d3_w[2 * i]; windowsFlat[2 * n + 1] = d3_w[2 * i + 1]; n++;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < d4.Length; i++)
        {
            if (d4_w[2 * i] > d4_w[2 * i + 1]) continue;
            windowsFlat[2 * n] = d4_w[2 * i]; windowsFlat[2 * n + 1] = d4_w[2 * i + 1]; n++;
            if (d4[i] != null && d4[i].writeRenderSettings) { atmosphereWindowsFlat = Grow(atmosphereWindowsFlat, 2 * na + 2); atmosphereWindowsFlat[2 * na] = d4_w[2 * i]; atmosphereWindowsFlat[2 * na + 1] = d4_w[2 * i + 1]; na++; }
            if (d4[i] != null && d4[i].writeMainLight) { sunWindowsFlat = Grow(sunWindowsFlat, 2 * ns + 2); sunWindowsFlat[2 * ns] = d4_w[2 * i]; sunWindowsFlat[2 * ns + 1] = d4_w[2 * i + 1]; ns++; }
        }
        // </LANBAI-GENERATED-WINDOWS>
        atmosphereWindowsFlat = Trim(atmosphereWindowsFlat, 2 * na);
        sunWindowsFlat = Trim(sunWindowsFlat, 2 * ns);
    }

    private float[] Grow(float[] a, int len)
    {
        if (a != null && a.Length >= len) return a;
        float[] r = new float[len];
        if (a != null) for (int i = 0; i < a.Length; i++) r[i] = a[i];
        return r;
    }

    private float[] Trim(float[] a, int len)
    {
        if (a == null) return new float[0];
        if (a.Length == len) return a;
        float[] r = new float[len];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) r[i] = a[i];
        return r;
    }

    // spawn: every driver root on for prewarmFrames dispatch calls (shaders and meshes get uploaded under the black),
    // then the normal window logic takes over and switches them off again
    public void LanbaiPrewarm()
    {
        _prewarm = prewarmFrames;
    }

    public void LanbaiDispatch(float t)
    {
        lastT = t;
        int act = 0;
        gradeOwned = false; gradeDEV = 0f; gradeWhiteSat = 0f; gradeWhiteBloom = 0f; gradeLensClean = 1f;
        bool hold = _prewarm > 0;
        if (_prewarm > 0) _prewarm--;
        // <LANBAI-GENERATED-DISPATCH>
        for (int i = 0; i < d0.Length; i++)
        {
            Lanbai.Act09.LanbaiAct09Driver d = d0[i];
            if (d == null) continue;
            bool inside = hold || (t >= d0_w[2 * i] && t < d0_w[2 * i + 1]);
            if (inside != d0_on[i]) { d.LanbaiActivate(inside); d0_on[i] = inside; }
            if (inside && !hold)
            {
                d.LanbaiTick(t); act++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < d1.Length; i++)
        {
            Lanbai.Sky.LanbaiSkyDriver d = d1[i];
            if (d == null) continue;
            bool inside = hold || (t >= d1_w[2 * i] && t < d1_w[2 * i + 1]);
            if (inside != d1_on[i]) { d.LanbaiActivate(inside); d1_on[i] = inside; }
            if (inside && !hold)
            {
                d.LanbaiTick(t); act++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < d2.Length; i++)
        {
            LanbaiAct07Driver d = d2[i];
            if (d == null) continue;
            bool inside = hold || (t >= d2_w[2 * i] && t < d2_w[2 * i + 1]);
            if (inside != d2_on[i]) { d.LanbaiActivate(inside); d2_on[i] = inside; }
            if (inside && !hold)
            {
                d.LanbaiTick(t); act++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < d3.Length; i++)
        {
            LanbaiGateDriver d = d3[i];
            if (d == null) continue;
            bool inside = hold || (t >= d3_w[2 * i] && t < d3_w[2 * i + 1]);
            if (inside != d3_on[i]) { d.LanbaiActivate(inside); d3_on[i] = inside; }
            if (inside && !hold)
            {
                d.LanbaiTick(t); act++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < d4.Length; i++)
        {
            LanbaiInsideDriver d = d4[i];
            if (d == null) continue;
            bool inside = hold || (t >= d4_w[2 * i] && t < d4_w[2 * i + 1]);
            if (inside != d4_on[i]) { d.LanbaiActivate(inside); d4_on[i] = inside; }
            if (inside && !hold)
            {
                d.LanbaiTick(t); act++;
                float[] g = d.LanbaiGrade(t);
                if (g != null && g.Length >= 4)
                {
                    gradeOwned = true; gradeDEV += g[0];
                    gradeWhiteSat = Mathf.Max(gradeWhiteSat, g[1]); gradeWhiteBloom = Mathf.Max(gradeWhiteBloom, g[2]);
                    gradeLensClean = Mathf.Min(gradeLensClean, g[3]);
                }
            }
        }
        // </LANBAI-GENERATED-DISPATCH>
        activeCount = act;
    }

    // true if some driver's window contains t (old placeholder groups; NOT the takeover switches, see v1.1)
    public bool LanbaiCovered(float t)
    {
        return Inside(windowsFlat, t);
    }

    // v1.1: true if a driver that writes RenderSettings fog / ambient is inside its window at t (LB_Journey: extAtmosphere)
    public bool LanbaiCoversAtmosphere(float t)
    {
        return Inside(atmosphereWindowsFlat, t);
    }

    // v1.1: true if a driver that writes the main light is inside its window at t (LB_Journey: extSun)
    public bool LanbaiCoversSun(float t)
    {
        return Inside(sunWindowsFlat, t);
    }

    private bool Inside(float[] w, float t)
    {
        if (w == null) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < w.Length; i += 2)
            if (t >= w[i] && t < w[i + 1]) return true;
        return false;
    }
}
